rows.title: ABACUS digital - Data Scientist, Analytics & Modeling
rows.description:
🔍Hot Job 🔥


At ABACUS digital, we are working hard to provide better access to credit for everyone, aiming to solve one of the fundamental problems in Thailand – financial inclusion. Our flagship product is the digital lending application, MoneyThunder, that is already used by more than one million people in Thailand. We are at the stage of scaling the impact beyond the first million.

 

One of the core technologies that power MoneyThunder is AI/ML and we strive to use machine learning to improve every aspect of our product, ranging from credit risks and collection strategy to user experience and user acquisition. As we scale,


we are planning to build a next-generation machine learning platform with even higher scalability and velocity to support more use cases of AI/ML in our business. And we are looking for talents like you to bring passion in software engineering and AI/ML and join our mission to build innovative technology for a good social cause.

​

What you will do

  • Build end-to-end machine learning or statistical models to use in our digital products from problem formulation, data collection, model development, and implementation.
  • Conduct research and analysis on various data sources to find predictive signals to help improve model performance.
  • Collaborate with other business units to help formulate business problems into data analytic, experimentation, or modeling problems.

 

What we are looking for

  • Strong background in probability, statistics, machine learning, or other quantitative areas of study.
  • Good understanding of end-to-end model development process from problem formulation to implementation.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with business units to help formulate problems into data analytics, experiments, or modeling problems.
  • Background in finance is optional, but one should have a strong interest in our business and fintech industry.
  • Programming skills in Python and SQL

The sewing machine industry is a global industry that is experiencing renewed growth. In developed markets, growth rates are projected to outpace GDP growth, according to Global Industry Analysts, Inc., the leading industry data source. Growth in these markets is driven by the millennial generation that is increasingly attracted to personalization, crafts, and self-expression. In developing markets, the industry is expected to grow at 4% annually, fueled by the emerging middle class and the “need to sew” segment that uses sewing machines to support the household.
